name: big-dill-workspace
description: Monorepo root. Not published — see core and extension.

scripts.// version: Never published (private: true), but npm sbom needs some version to generate a PURL for the workspace root — without one, `npm sbom` fails for every workspace member with EINVALIDPURLTYPE, not just this package.
scripts.// postinstall: The extension resolves @nokout/big-dill-core through its package.json `types`/`main`, which point into dist/. Nothing else builds core first, so without this every consumer — CI, a fresh clone, esbuild — fails with 'Cannot find module'. Building on install makes the dependency order automatic rather than something each job has to remember.
